question: Does the parastatal publish its financial statements or annual accouts within a specified timeline?
step2_answer: ANSWER: Not determinable. No source in the Citation Sheet shows that BDA's annual financial statements or annual accounts are published online. No source shows a specified timeline for publishing or approving them. | EVIDENCE: (1) BDA-03 (Annual Report 2026, p.79) says: "Accounts Audit for the financial year 2024-25 has been finalized." It also says the Finance wing deals with "preparation and approval of Annual Budget of the Authority, maintenance of Accounts". This shows accounts were audited. It does not show the statements are published, or that they were approved within a deadline. (2) BDA-20, BDA-21 and BDA-22 are Local Fund Audit reports on BDA accounts for 2011-12, 2013-14 and 2014-15, dated 2016, 2015 and 2017. They are government audit documents, not BDA's own publication of financial statements. They show audits were completed 1 to 5 years after the year-end. BDA-21 cites s.80 of the ODA Act 1982 for the annual budget, and BDA-22 cites rule 100 of the ODA Rules 1983 for maintaining cash books. Neither is a timeline for publishing annual accounts. (3) BDA-08, BDA-09, BDA-10 and BDA-19 are the Planning and Building Standards rules and regulations. They have no accounts-publication provision. | CAVEATS: Annual Report 2026 is a published document, but it only mentions that the audit was finalised. A score of 0 needs affirmative absence: a checked BDA website with no statements, or no mandated timeline. That was not established. The ODA Act's accounts and audit sections
